issues.description: Default base image 'python:3.12' is duplicated across three locations with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: The constant is defined in backend/kale/pipeline.py, hardcoded as a fallback in Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage, and redeclared as DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE in CellMetadataEditor.tsx. This defeats the purpose of the new RPC — a bump to python:3.13 will silently leave two stale copies. Either trust the RPC and render an explicit 'unknown' on failure, or don't add the RPC.

issues.description: Silent semantic change in _set_base_image: empty fallback now pins python:3.12 instead of deferring to KFP's default.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' let KFP choose its own default on pod-introspection failure. Now it pins python:3.12, conflating 'unspecified' with a concrete value. This is a runtime behavior change for every failing-pod path, not the UI cosmetic the PR advertises. Split the semantic change from the display change and discuss separately.

issues.description: Replacing the inline Input with a 5%-wide 'IMAGE' button opening a modal is a UX regression.
issues.detail: The previous UI showed the current base image inline and editable in one click. The new button hides state behind a modal, requires an extra click for the common edit case, and the 5% width on an unspecified container is unreasoned and likely to clip. Keep the inline input; show the default as placeholder or helper text.

issues.description: Effective-image precedence logic is duplicated between the Jinja template and InlineMetadata.tsx.
issues.detail: The template computes 'step.config.base_image or base_image or default_base_image' while TS computes 'baseImage or pipelineBaseImage or defaultBaseImage or DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE'. Two implementations of one rule in two languages will drift. Name the resolution once (e.g. resolveBaseImage) and call it from both display and compile paths.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders an element, breaking the prior empty-string sentinel contract.
issues.detail: The function previously returned '' when no baseImage was set; it now unconditionally renders 'Base Image: <default> (default)'. Callers that relied on absence (non-step cells, layout flow, conditional spacing) may now show meaningless base image lines. Audit the caller paths and gate by cellType, or restore the absence sentinel.

issues.description: RPC round-trip to return a compile-time constant is gratuitous and failure-prone.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image wraps a Python string literal in a network call, complete with try/catch and a hardcoded fallback. A build-time inject or inclusion in an existing bootstrap RPC (alongside kfpUiHost) would deliver the value once with no fallback drift. The current design adds a round trip and then duplicates the constant as a safety net.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges strongly: the PR advertises a display feature but executes it with duplication and a smuggled semantic change. The default 'python:3.12' now lives in three places (pipeline.py, Commands.ts fallback, CellMetadataEditor.tsx constant) with no mechanism guaranteeing they agree, defeating the new RPC's purpose. The change to _set_base_image silently rewrites runtime behavior on pod-inspection failure, which all three reviewers flag as out-of-scope for a display PR. The button-plus-modal replacing an inline Input is a UX regression. Recommended path: consolidate the default to one source, split the semantic change into its own PR, and reconsider the modal.
